[Verse 1]
[C#]When the rain is blowing in
[G#]your face
[G#m]And the whole world is
[F#]on your case
[F#m]I could offer you a warm
[C#]embrace
[D#9]To make you [A#madd11/D#]feel my love
[C#]

[Verse 2]
[C#]When the evening shadows and the stars
[G#]appear
[G#m]And there is no one there to dry
[F#]your tears
[F#m]I could hold you for a
[C#]million years
[D#9]To make you [A#madd11/D#]feel my love
[C#]

[Bridge]
[F#]I know you haven't made your
[C#]mind up yet
[C#aug]But I would [F#/C#]never do you wrong
[C#]
[F#]I’ve known it from the moment
[C#]that we met
[D#9]No doubt in my mind where you belong
[G#]

[Verse 3]
[C#]I'd go hungry, I'd go
[G#]black and blue
[G#m]I'd go crawling down the
[F#]avenue
[F#m]I know there's nothing that I
[C#]wouldn't do
[D#9]To make you [A#madd11/D#]feel my love
[C#]

[Interlude]
[C#]
[G#]
[G#m]
[F#]
[F#m]
[C#]
[D#9]  [A#madd11/D#]
[C#]

[Bridge]
[F#]The storms are raging on the
[C#]rolling sea
[C#aug]And on the [F#/C#]highway of regret
[C#]
[F#]The winds of change are blowing
[C#]wild and free
[D#9]You ain't seen nothing like me
[G#]yet

[Verse 4]
[C#]I could make you happy, make your
[G#]dreams come true
[G#m]Nothing that I would-
[F#]n't do
[F#m]Go to the ends of the
[C#]earth for you
[D#9]To make you [A#madd11/D#]feel my love
[C#]

[Outro]
[C#]
[G#]
[G#m]
[F#]

[Fade-Out]
[F#m]
[C#]
[D#9]  [A#madd11/D#]
[C#]
